design: Retrospective source audit; new healthy-state control analyses. Settings fixed before new outcome calculation; not prospectively preregistered.
source: all 88 ds004504 derivatives; AD/control primary, AD/FTD specificity secondary
spectral: FOOOF 1.1.1 fixed background 2-30 Hz, widths 1-8 Hz, max 6 peaks, min height .1 log10, threshold 2; reject fits R2<.8 or error>.15; report exclusions and no-peak cases
source_windows: original first 8s plus first/middle/last60s; 128Hz; Welch8s50percent overlap for 60s; no overlap for8s
lemon: all available older age-bin lower-bound >=55; first60s per EO/EC preprocessed condition; exact19 names using T3=T7,T4=T8,T5=P7,T6=P8; exclude missing channels; paired person endpoints: native frozen score,19channel average-reference frozen score,log posterior/frontal alpha,log theta/alpha; first vs last30s stability; derivatives may concatenate blocks
cap: all16 healthy IDs n1-n16; first30min only; first10 complete30s epochs in W/S1/S2; at least3epochs perstate; same-side frontal F3/F4 and occipital O1/O2 with same A1/A2 reference; priority left then right; no inferred electrodes; paired W-S1 and W-S2 regional logalpha ratio and logthetaalpha; ECG time-locked artifact sensitivity if ECG available, descriptive not autonomic causation
inference: person-level bootstrap5000; group two-sided MannWhitney Holm across all group endpoints; paired signflip10000 + bootstrap5000 Holm across all state endpoints. Missing comparisons recorded, not selected away. No train/test splitting windows as people.
